purpose: Scratch native ordered-key seek versus ordinal offset research, not S0.2 or application acceptance
changes: Only /tmp/rebase-order-study files and owned temporary stores; no repository edits or Cargo invocation
toolchain: rustc 1.95.0 (59807616e 2026-04-14), direct -O compilation reusing existing release dependencies

host.topology: One Linux host; embedded Rust process for redb/SurrealKV; one owned local FDB server process and Rust client over loopback; no multi-host results

data.key: 2-byte prefix p/ then big-endian u64; source generator xorshift seed0x6a09e667f3bcc909, increments1..31
data.extra: q/outside extra entry proves whole-table count and selector scope differ from prefix
data.source_count: Expected from independently generated source vector length, not database metadata

sampling.clock: std::time::Instant; elapsed includes transaction+iterator/read setup, final result validation and drops
sampling.order: Fixed backend/operation/rank sequence in source, not randomized; no affinity pinning, no cold-cache controls
sampling.SurrealKV: Durable tree closed using default flush_on_close and reopened before full warm correctness pass and timing; default storage settings
sampling.FDB: Fresh single ssd cluster; batches1000 source entries committed before read trials; each operation fresh non-snapshot read transaction

counter_definitions.embedded_client_visible_items_examined: Explicit public iterator/cursor entries visited; excludes internal tree/LSM page and I/O work
counter_definitions.FDB_client_returned_items: Public binding returned entries; native selectors1, scan ordinalK returnsK+1
counter_definitions.FDB_binding_read_calls: Invocations of get_key or get_range, excluding transaction creation, client implementation internals, read-version requests and network exchanges
counter_definitions.FDB_server_scanned_items: Uninstrumented null; no conversion of client call counts to disk/network requests

limits: Small warmed local measurements, not asymptotic proof or production scaling/latency claims
Known-key source vector supplies key; finding unknown rank is the separate ordinal operation
No application AVL, rank cache or auxiliary tree in measured database paths
redb metadata len applies to entire table, not arbitrary prefix; prefix counting here explicitly iterates
Native FDB selectors return one key through one binding call while server offset processing remains uninstrumented
No writes, contention, concurrent mutation, shard-boundary stress, repeated process trials or multi-host campaign measured
